tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pa la bstod pa bsam dgu'i sbrang rtsi 'jo ba'i mgrin snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// mnyam pa'i britta bcu gsum pa shin tu skye 'gro la ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi dgongs pas prast+rā ra brgyad stong chig brgya go gnyis/ naṣṭata ya zung dang ga sa uddiṣṭa bdun brgya gya gcig yang ba'i bya yang ba 'dod pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa/ yi ge'i grangs chig 'bum drug stong bzhi brgya go drug lci yang so so'i grangs lnga khri sum stong nyis brgya zhe brgyad/ phyi mo chig 'bum lnga khri dgu stong bdun brgya zhe bzhi/ a dhwa 'phreng nyer lnga/ steng 'og chig khri drug stong sum brgya gsum pa gzhung gi dngos zin min pas mdzes pa'o// ༄༅// wāgind+rakumāraṣyadzñānadayauḥshukro3dhwān+yatanurāgasyotpādanayākāntā/ dzātastaramānandaḥpaṇḍitamatyagraḥprotpannadzinaṃputrast+waṃpadatiṣṭhantu// ༄༅// ngagaṃ gzugs can gyi rgyan las bsdus dang ma bsdus bsres pa'i gzugs/ dbangaṃ gzhon nu'i mkhyen brtse'i ti la kaḥ /gzhan don rjes chags skyed byed dam pa yis// bskyed bsrings mkhas pa kunaṃ dgaṃ'i bloṃ grosaṃ rtsal// rab rdzogs rgyal ba'i sras khyod zhabs brtan shog /mdo sngags 'gog rgyan las chos can 'gog pa/ gzhung don mkhas pa'i tshul chen gsum// mgrin las 'jo ba dpyad gsum dag go zhes// dpyod pa 'di ci rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang*// mtha' dag 'di la gcig tu rdzogs phyir ro// ji snyed rgyu rgyan las spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ shes bya'i yul la ma sbyangs pa// 'ga' yang rgyal sras rnams kyi thugs la med// gang phyir zab dang yangs pa'i chos kun la// chags thogs bral pa'i ngo mtshar dpag tu ci// sna tshogs bai dharbhar 'don pa'i rgya che ba/ 'gro bas gnas skabs mthar thug gi /bsam don gsol ba btab dgu de dang des// re ba phyur bur 'gengs khyod thob tsam gyis// cher rlom gzhan la 'dun pa cis mi lhod// yang

dpe rgyan las rmongs pa'i dpe/ dag bstan dang sems can phan pa'i las// lhun grub rgyun mi chad 'di sangs rgyas kyi// mdzad pa las gzhan dmigs su ma rnyed par// de yi cha shas bstod pa'i snyan dngags 'bul/ dpe rgyan las ngag don gyi bzhin sgra gcig pa/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos bla mar bstod pa'i dge /thub mchog bka' don smra mkhas sa skya pa'i// bstan pa'i bshad sgrub phrin las rta bdun pa'i// 'od zer gyis bzhin sa steng khyab phyir bsngo// tshul yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa las drangs pa'i shis brjod/ 'dis bstod bdag 'di nas byang chub bar// skye bar skyabs mchog rigs kyi cod paṇa 'chang*// thams cad mkhyen lam thos bsam bsgoms byung gi /lung rtogs yon tan rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan par bstod pa bsam dgu'i sbrang rtsi len pa'i mgrin snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang blor 'dun pa'i sa bon gyis sbrum pa la/ skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' lung gi phrin las skyong ba'i mdo sngags rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bzang po pa'i gsung bskul drod gsher gyi rkyen 'dzom pa'i tshe/ dad pa'i nor can bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ sde dge lhun grub sting gi rgyal khab kyi bsti gnas su bris pa dge legs dar bar gyur cig/ // ༄// dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan par sngags brjod bung ba'i mgrin snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng phyug smon lam shing rtar brten// dpyod ldan kunaṃ dgaṃ'i bloṃ grosaṃ nyin mor byed// 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i 'od rtses sangaṃs rgyasaṃ kyi// bstanaṃ paṃ'i sbrang rtsi'i rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn bzhad la 'dud// rigs drug rgyal ba byang chub sems dpa' dang*// phyogs kyi bgegs dgra rang rang dga' mar bcas// kun 'dus gar gyis 'gro ba sku bzhi'i sar// smin grol byed por bskal par zhabs brtan shog

/bsngags brjod bung ba'i mgrin snyan glur blangs pas// gsang gsum byin rlabs ge sar bcud 'thung zhing*// lung rtogs yon tan gshog rtsal rab rdzogs nas// grub gnyis mkha' dbyings zlos gar rtsen par shog /ces dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan par bsngags brjod bung ba'i mgrin snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos rje bstan 'dzin dbang phyug pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyi sa lhag pa lag sor 'dzom pa'i tshes dge bar brin pa bi dza ya tu// ༈ /ngaṃg dbaṃng gzhon nu gangs can 'gro 'dul phyir// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa kunaṃ dgaṃ'i bloṃ groṃs can// riṃn cheṃn gsum 'dus mkhas pa'i 'phrin las kyi// miṃ 'gyuraṃ bstan pa'i rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn slong bas skyongs// lha mchog ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng phyug mkhas pa kunaṃ// dgaṃ' bskyed legaṃs pa'i lam kun 'byungaṃ ba'i gnas// sangaṃs rgyasaṃ bstan pa yongs bzung phrin las rgyun// bzaṃng poṃs 'gro ba 'dren mdzad rtag tu skyongs// tshulaṃ khrimaṃs rnam gsum bslab pa'i sgor zhugs nas// gtsug lag riṃn cheṃn 'od snang 'phro ba ste// rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs rnam lnga yi// gsang gsum byin brlabs byang chub bar du skyongs// skye ba kun du sogs dang*/ skye zhing skye ba dag ni sogs brjod do// zhes sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ rab 'byams sangs rgyas bzang po/ kho bo cag ste skyabs yul rnam lngar bstod gsol mu tig mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang hor yul gdong thog bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen ngor/ bande tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
